M-XML.NAME: Strict XML layer
M-XML.purpose: Parse and validate MyGRACE project XML with fast-xml-parser and expose small typed accessors (ADR-2).

export-INDEX_TAG_RE.PURPOSE: Grammar of index entry tags: M-XXX, V-M-XXX and Phase-N.

fn-validateXml.PURPOSE: Well-formedness check with line/column, null when valid.

fn-parseXml.PURPOSE: Validate then parse; throws XmlError on malformed input.

fn-parseIndexEntries.PURPOSE: Structural index entries with attributes and a rendered raw tag.

fn-indexEntriesFromDocument.PURPOSE: Index entries from an already parsed document.

fn-parseAttributes.PURPOSE: Legacy helper: attributes from a raw tag body string.

fn-findElements.PURPOSE: Filter all elements of a document by predicate.

fn-childElements.PURPOSE: Direct child elements, optionally filtered by tag.

fn-childElement.PURPOSE: First direct child with the given tag.

fn-textOf.PURPOSE: Trimmed direct text content of an element.

contract.purpose: Parse and validate MyGRACE project XML with fast-xml-parser and expose small typed accessors (ADR-2).

param.name: content
param.description: Raw XML text read by a caller.

param.name: document
param.description: Root element plus a flat element list in document order.

notes.note-1: Comments, CDATA wrappers and processing instructions are not elements, so template examples never leak into results.
notes.note-2: Attribute quoting, attribute values containing > or quotes, and Phase-1a names are handled by the parser, not by regexes.
notes.note-3: Every reader in MyGRACE (indexes, entities, MCP payloads) goes through this module so behaviour cannot drift.
